comparisons.name: window-controls-light
comparisons.description: The left end of the title bar in the Aqua capture, 68 by 22 pt: the three window controls at x 8, 28 and 48 pt, y 5 pt, and above and below them the bar's two highlight rows and two bottom rows. The picture in the capture is a third party's movie and the demo shows an abstract placeholder instead, so the whole window is not compared. The bar is translucent and its fill is partly the picture behind it: the fill is masked, everything between the edge rows except the three 12 pt squares that hold the controls (62% of the crop). What stays in the score and still depends on the picture: the corners of those squares, which are bar fill, and the highlight rows, which let about a seventh of the picture through.

comparisons.name: title-bar-bottom-light
comparisons.description: The last point of the title bar in the Aqua capture across the whole window, 1470 by 1 pt: its two bottom rows. Both are opaque in the demo, the library's Dark Aqua shadow row #2a2a2a and separator #000000, so this score does not depend on the placeholder picture. The separator is #000000 in the capture too; the capture's shadow row lets the movie through (#2a2a2b to #404243), and where the movie is light it differs from the library's row, which is the mismatch at 2x.

comparisons.name: title-bar-material-light
comparisons.description: The title bar over the placeholder picture, window of the Aqua capture's size. No comparison with the capture can score the bar's fill: it is translucent, so in the capture it is partly the movie, which the demo does not reproduce (against the capture the whole strip mismatches by 17% and the highlight rows by 13%, nearly all of it the picture's difference). Over the placeholder's gradient the bar's colours follow from the tokens, and these pixels hold them, away from the title: --mac-material-filter makes #2d3645 of the gradient behind the bar (#31363e at its mid-height, saturated to 180%), --mac-title-bar-translucent lies over that, then the title bar's highlight rows and the window's rim.

comparisons.name: controller-geometry-light
comparisons.description: The floating controller in the window of the Aqua capture's size: 440 by 75 pt, half a point right of the centre, its bottom edge 127.5 pt above the window's, as measured in the capture (x 515.5 to 955.5, y 624.5 to 699.5 pt). No comparison with the capture can score it: the panel is a vibrant material and its glyphs add light to it, so in the capture every pixel of it is partly the movie, which the demo does not reproduce (against the capture the crop mismatches by 96%). The placeholder is one flat grey, #707070, where the controller lies, and over a flat grey the panel's colours follow from the tokens: these pixels hold the panel's four edges, seven glyphs, the volume knob and the timeline to those colours at the measured places. The time codes are text in the fallback font and the Share glyph is a thin outline: neither is checked. The controller's own look is held the same way, over a flat grey, by the HUD Window component (hud-window.visual.json), which compares only the opaque volume knob with the captures.
